doc.brief: The QListWidgetItem class provides an item for use with the [QListWidget](xref:qt:QListWidget) item view class.
doc.index_brief: Item for use with the QListWidget item view class

QBrush background() const.brief: Returns the brush used to display the list item's background.

QBrush foreground() const.brief: Returns the brush used to display the list item's foreground (e.g. text).

QDataStream & operator<<(QDataStream &ou.brief: Writes the list widget item *item* to stream *out*.

QDataStream & operator>>(QDataStream &in.brief: Reads a list widget item from stream *in* into *item*.

QFont font() const.brief: Returns the font used to display this list item's text.

QListWidget * listWidget() const.brief: Returns the list widget containing the item.

QListWidgetItem * clone() const.brief: Creates an exact copy of the item.

QListWidgetItem(QListWidget *parent, int.brief: Constructs an empty list widget item of the specified *type* with the given *parent*.

QListWidgetItem(const QIcon &icon, const.brief: Constructs an empty list widget item of the specified *type* with the given *icon*, *text* and *parent*.

QListWidgetItem(const QString &text, QLi.brief: Constructs an empty list widget item of the specified *type* with the given *text* and *parent*.

QSize sizeHint() const.brief: Returns the size hint set for the list item.

QString statusTip() const.brief: Returns the list item's status tip.

QString whatsThis() const.brief: Returns the list item's "What's This?" help text.

QVariant data(int role) const.brief: Returns the item's data for a given *role*.

Qt::CheckState checkState() const.brief: Returns the checked state of the list item (see [Qt::CheckState](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qt.html#CheckState-enum)).

Qt::ItemFlags flags() const.brief: Returns the item flags for this item (see [Qt::ItemFlags](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qt.html#ItemFlag-enum)).

bool isHidden() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is hidden; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isSelected() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is selected; otherwise returns `false`.

bool operator<(const QListWidgetItem &ot.brief: Returns `true` if this item's text is less then *other* item's text; otherwise returns `false`.

int textAlignment() const.brief: Returns the text alignment for the list item.

int type() const.brief: Returns the type passed to the [QListWidgetItem](xref:qt:QListWidgetItem) constructor.

void setBackground(const QBrush &brush).brief: Sets the background brush of the list item to the given *brush*.

void setCheckState(Qt::CheckState state).brief: Sets the check state of the list item to *state*.

void setData(int role, const QVariant &v.brief: Sets the data for a given *role* to the given *value*.

void setFlags(Qt::ItemFlags flags).brief: Sets the item flags for the list item to *flags*.

void setFont(const QFont &font).brief: Sets the font used when painting the item to the given *font*.

void setForeground(const QBrush &brush).brief: Sets the foreground brush of the list item to the given *brush*.

void setHidden(bool hide).brief: Hides the item if *hide* is true; otherwise shows the item.

void setIcon(const QIcon &icon).brief: Sets the icon for the list item to the given *icon*.

void setSelected(bool select).brief: Sets the selected state of the item to *select*.

void setSizeHint(const QSize &size).brief: Sets the size hint for the list item to be *size*.

void setStatusTip(const QString &statusT.brief: Sets the status tip for the list item to the text specified by *statusTip*.

void setText(const QString &text).brief: Sets the text for the list widget item's to the given *text*.

void setTextAlignment(Qt::Alignment alig.brief: Sets the list item's text alignment to *alignment*.

void setToolTip(const QString &toolTip).brief: Sets the tooltip for the list item to the text specified by *toolTip*.

void setWhatsThis(const QString &whatsTh.brief: Sets the "What's This?" help for the list item to the text specified by *whatsThis*.
